epics.title: Make Photonz the best UX redlining tool

Alignment checking

epics.title: Interaction foundations: the primitives everything sits on
epics.note: The shared architecture the pillar epics build on top of, so it comes early. Source of truth: shared/UX-PATTERNS.md. A surface that needs chrome outside this vocabulary is a signal to fix the foundation, not to invent locally.

The one color picker, everywhere a color lives
